findings.issue: Confirmed by reading the workflow: the `db` job's `services:` block starts ONLY `postgres:16` (no Flowable) and its steps run `npm run fitness:db` with no FLOWABLE_PORT/FLOWABLE_REST_* env set. The separate `flowable` job runs `docker compose up -d postgres flowable` + its own static/smoke checks, but never calls `npm run fitness:db`. `requireDbAndFlowable()` in both engine-drive-*.db.test.ts files silently `console.log('[skip] Flowable not reachable...')` and returns without failing when unreachable. Net effect: ci/checks/db/engine-drive-generic.db.test.ts and engine-drive-completedby.db.test.ts have NEVER actually asserted anything in any automated GitHub Actions run to date — 'green in CI' for these two files has always meant 'silently skipped in CI', confirming the builder's diagnosis (1) exactly. This is a PRE-EXISTING CI-topology gap, not introduced or worsened by T-0760's test-only diff — T-0760 fixes the seed so the tests are honest LOCALLY, but does not (and was not scoped to) make them run in automated CI.
findings.suggestion: Non-blocking for T-0760. Follow-up candidate for the orchestrator to file: either (a) add Flowable as a service/compose dependency to the `db` job (or a new job) that actually runs `npm run fitness:db`, or (b) move the Flowable-dependent db-tier files into the `flowable` job's own test invocation, so this class of test stops being permanently CI-invisible.
